_13.4.9 – Build artifacts and temporary state do not persist after deployment_

This is a very low risk. 

In  containerized systems, this is mostly automatic. In monoliths, it's hard to test or verify without ops access.

I think it's just noise and can go.

_13.4.9 – Verify that data, state information, and server instances related to the build and deployment process do not persist after the process has ended. (Ephemerality)._

This is a very low risk. 

In  containerized systems, this is mostly automatic. In monoliths, it's hard to test or verify without ops access.

I think it's just noise and can go.
